name: coordguard
description: Hard anti-clobber guard for multi-instance Claude Code. On Write/Edit it blocks (PreToolUse deny) when the target file changed on disk since this session last read it — the signature of another Claude instance editing the same file. Kept separate from coordkit so the bus stays strictly never-blocks. Files this session modifies via its own Bash commands (sed -i, formatters, git checkout) no longer trip the guard: every Bash call is bracketed by a fingerprint snapshot/absorb pair, so self-inflicted changes are auto-attributed while a sibling's earlier edit still denies.
